domain_judgments.rationale: Although a computer-generated random table was used, allocation concealment was not reported and the very large, internally mis-analysed sex imbalance plus markedly unequal group sizes raise substantial concern about implementation of the randomization process.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Eligible patients meeting inclusion criteria were randomly allocated into three subgroups using a computer-generated random table.

domain_judgments.rationale: Participants and clinicians could not realistically be blinded to these visibly different procedures, and the report gives no information on intervention deviations, crossovers, or whether analyses followed intention-to-treat, although all randomized patients appear in the reported group totals.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Out of 454 patients assessed for suitability, only 414 patients enrolled in our study, randomized as 153 patients (37%), 117 patients (28%) and 144 patients (35%) in F-URS, ESWL and Mini PCNL group respectively.

domain_judgments.rationale: The two-week primary outcome is tabulated for all 414 randomized participants, with group category counts summing to each randomized group total and no losses reported.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Flexible ureteroscope group N = 153; ESWL group N = 117; Mini PCNL group N = 144.

domain_judgments.rationale: The stone-free outcome had a common stated definition, but the imaging method and blinded assessment were not reported, and assessment at only two weeks differentially disadvantages ESWL because fragment clearance takes longer, which the authors explicitly acknowledge.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: So, the two weeks follow up may have underestimated the true stone free rate for ESWL group as some patients may have require a longer duration of follow up to fully clear stone fragments.

domain_judgments.rationale: The trial was registered only after recruitment and follow-up had ended, no prespecified protocol or statistical analysis plan is presented, and numerous outcomes, categories, and pairwise analyses permit selective reporting.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: This prospective comparative interventional study enrolled 414 adult patients ... between March 2021 and September 2023 ... Trial Registration ... NCT06120257 ... on 15/12/2023.

overall_summary: Overall risk of bias is high, driven by concerns about the randomization process, differential outcome measurement at an early two-week time point that disadvantages ESWL, and retrospective trial registration with substantial scope for selective reporting. Additional concerns arise from absent reporting on allocation concealment, blinding, deviations, and intention-to-treat analysis.
